items_all.title: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户
items_all.summary: Cursor 发现通过其 IDE 扩展市场分发的 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被修改并植入恶意软件，最多影响 5000 用户，恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发。Cursor 已于当日下午下线扩展市场，与相关提供方合作清除恶意软件并确认无进一步风险后重新上线，建议受影响用户参考博客说明排查，并升级到 Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314。
items_all.title_original: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
items_all.title_en: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
items_all.title_zh: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户
items_all.title_bilingual: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户 / We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...

en.summary: Cursor discovered that the Claude Code VS Code extension distributed through its IDE extension marketplace had been tampered with and implanted with malware, affecting up to 5,000 users; the malicious version was not developed by Anthropic. Cursor took the marketplace offline that afternoon and restored it after working with the relevant providers to remove the malware and confirm there was no further risk. Affected users should refer to the blog post to check their systems and upgrade to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.

items_all.summary: 月之暗面（Kimi）发布官方教程，详解 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 3D 创作工作流程，说明参数化建模与网格化建模两种方式及对应工具选择。文章分享了 4 个案例的具体操作，包括在 Unreal Engine 中构建东方天宫、制作可 3D 打印的台灯、纯代码调用 Blender 生成建筑、用 Tripo 和 Blender 搭建微缩城市，并给出图胜于言、先搭灰模再细化等 5 个使用技巧。

en.title: Kimi official tutorial: How to create 3D artwork with Kimi K3.1 Pro
en.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released an official tutorial detailing the 3D creation workflow for Kimi K3.1 Pro, covering parametric modeling and mesh modeling along with how to choose the right tools for each. The post walks through four case studies: building an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, making a 3D-printable desk lamp, generating architecture by calling Blender purely through code, and building a miniature city with Tripo and Blender. It also shares five tips, including "show, don't tell" and blocking out a grey model before adding detail.

items_all.summary: 亚马逊财报电话会上，CEO Andy Jassy 重申 AWS 可在未来五到十年成为万亿美元年营收业务，预计 2026 年现金资本开支约 2200 亿美元，其中大部分投向 AWS，2027 年还将大幅增加。AWS 当季营收同比增长 39%，年化营收运行率达 1840 亿美元，Jassy 预测 2027 和 2028 年增速均可超 40%；财报后盘后交易中亚马逊股价下跌约 6%。

en.summary: On Amazon’s earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy reiterated that AWS can become a trillion-dollar annual revenue business within five to ten years. He expects about $220 billion in cash capex in 2026, most of it going to AWS, with a substantial increase again in 2027. AWS revenue grew 39% year over year in the quarter, with an annualized run rate of $184 billion, and Jassy expects growth to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028. Amazon shares fell about 6% in after-hours trading following the report.

items_all.summary: Reddit 在 Q3 财报中宣布将转向以登录为主的体验，以保护数据免受 AI 抓取并提升广告变现。10 月搜索流量平均每周减少超 100 万次引荐，Q3 全球日活为 1.303 亿，其中美国日活降至 5070 万，同比降 2%。Q3 收入同比增长 53% 至 8.95 亿美元，净利润 2.83 亿美元；该转变将先在美国以外市场测试，暂无全球上线时间表。

en.summary: Reddit announced in its Q3 earnings that it will shift to a login-first experience to protect its data from AI scraping and improve ad monetization. In October, search traffic averaged more than 1 million fewer referrals per week; Q3 global daily active users were 130.3 million, with US DAUs falling to 50.7 million, down 2% year over year. Q3 revenue rose 53% year over year to $895 million, with net income of $283 million; the shift will first be tested in markets outside the US, with no global rollout timeline yet.

en.summary: Unsloth has released a Dynamic 1-bit GGUF of Mistral Le Chonk (Mistral Large 4, a 1T-parameter MoE with 52B active), which can run locally on a Mac Studio, retains 91% top-1 accuracy, and is about 233GB (80% smaller than the 1.1TB FP8 version). A chart details hardware requirements by quantization tier: 1-bit needs 256–270GB of memory, while the smallest UD-IQ1_S takes about 233GB of disk. It supports text and image input, a 1M context window, and 160+ languages. The GGUF and guide are at huggingface.co/unsloth/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-GGUF and unsloth.ai/docs/models/mistral-large-4.

en.title: What can Personal Agent actually get done in mainland China?
en.summary: The author tested Grok Bot, Muse, Dots, and Instinct on the same set of tasks. The hands-on test covered eight general scenarios across four categories: information and communication (email, calendar), proactive and scheduled tasks (monitoring financial markets, scheduled coffee orders), end-to-end consumer and travel tasks (booking hotels, buying train tickets, hailing rides), and finding events (filtering upcoming AI events). Let's see how they performed!

items_all_raw.summary: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk（Mistral Large 4，1T 参数 MoE，52B 激活）的 Dynamic 1-bit GGUF，可在 Mac Studio 上本地运行，保留 91% top-1 准确率，体积约 233GB（较 1.1TB FP8 小 80%）。图为各量化档位给出硬件需求，1-bit 需 256-270GB 内存，最小 UD-IQ1_S 约占 233GB 磁盘，并支持文本与图像输入、1M 上下文和 160+ 语言。GGUF 与指南见 huggingface.co/unsloth/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-GGUF 和 unsloth.ai/docs/models/mistral-large-4。
